in_marathi.name: Dhohanth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessed with prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhohanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhana’, meaning wealth. The prefix ‘dhoh’ signifies the one who is blessed with it. This name is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity in one's life.
